title: HHHusher use-case cards
description: Dark photo cards on a camel band. A wide card carries a title top-left and a row of tabs at the bottom: the open tab is a wide yellow panel with a number, a paragraph and an arrow link, the others narrow glass tiles that outline on hover; clicking one swaps the photo with a slow fade. Below, a tall card left and two stacked cards right, each with a title, a paragraph and a yellow arrow link. Cards fade in as they enter and their photos drift slowly against the scroll.
notes: the band is the theme's secondary (tan); the cards wrap themselves in .dark
media per tab and per card; empty slots show a dark placeholder at the same size
no top padding of its own: it follows hhhusher-statement; add pt-section when used alone
tabs need JavaScript (hydrate: visible); without it the first tab stays open
